# Typed client SDKs (generated by APIMatic)

TypeScript and Python clients for the provable.bid API, generated by
[APIMatic](https://www.apimatic.io/) (`@apimatic/cli` 2.0.0, code generator v4) from
[`contracts/openapi.yaml`](../contracts/openapi.yaml). Do not edit the generated files by hand; regenerate them.

| Folder | Package | Import | Client |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`typescript/`](typescript) | `provable-bid-sdk` (npm name, not published) | `provable-bid-sdk` | `ProvableBidApiClient` |
| [`python/`](python) | `provable_bid_sdk` (PyPI name, not published) | `provable_bid_api` | `ProvableBidApiClient` |

Each SDK covers the contract's 40 public operations (the two `/__mock/*` operations, which exist only on a
fake-payments server, are left out). The default server is the live sandbox API,
`https://provable-race-api.onrender.com` (`production` environment); `environment2` is the local API at
`http://127.0.0.1:4010`. Authenticated calls take a bearer token: an agent token (`pba_…`), a buyer session or an
operator credential. Each SDK has its own README, an `api-reference.md` and an `sdk-map.md`.

## Use

TypeScript (Node 20.3+):

```ts
import { ProvableBidApiClient } from "provable-bid-sdk";

const client = new ProvableBidApiClient({ bearerAuth: process.env.PB_TOKEN });
const config = await client.system.getConfig();
const page = await client.competitions.listCompetitions({ limit: 100 });
const open = page.items.filter((c) => c.state === "open");
```

Python (3.10+):

```python
import os
from provable_bid_api import ProvableBidApiClient

with ProvableBidApiClient(bearer_auth=os.environ["PB_TOKEN"]) as client:
    config = client.system.get_config()
    page = client.competitions.list_competitions(limit=100)
    open_briefs = [c for c in page.items if c.state == "open"]
```

Install from this folder: `npm install ./sdks/typescript` (its `prepare` script builds `dist/`) or
`pip install ./sdks/python`.

## Regenerate

```bash
scripts/apimatic-sdks.sh            # both languages
scripts/apimatic-sdks.sh python     # one language
```

It needs an APIMatic API key in `APIMATIC_API_KEY` or in a one-line file at `~/.apimatic-key` (override with
`APIMATIC_KEY_FILE`). The key is passed to the CLI per call; nothing is written to the repo. The script:

1. builds the generator input in a temp directory with
   [`scripts/apimatic/prepare-spec.mjs`](../scripts/apimatic/prepare-spec.mjs), plus
   [`APIMATIC-META.json`](../scripts/apimatic/APIMATIC-META.json) and the
   [package settings](../scripts/apimatic/package-settings) (package names);
2. runs APIMatic validation (`apimatic api validate`) and stops on errors;
3. generates each SDK (`apimatic sdk generate`) and replaces `sdks/<language>`.

The contract itself is never edited. `prepare-spec.mjs` only changes the generator's copy: it makes the live sandbox
API the default server, drops `/__mock/*`, fills the APIMatic validation errors the contract trips (operations
without a description reuse their summary; a nullable enum and an integer enum are reshaped), and works around two
generator issues (`const` response-header schemas, and `application/problem+json` error bodies, which are declared
as `application/json` so the SDKs decode the Problem body on errors).
